chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent closes the unrelated new-post composer, visibly correcting that detour. It later independently reopens and closes the composer, then navigates Home and Settings without any observed list-management view or list mutation. Thus the target action itself is not an observed bridge to the required list configuration, and its harmful mechanism is interrupted by correction.

summary: The reused Saved-tab summary did not visibly drive the reuse-target action toward the requested list configuration; that action exited an unrelated composer. No requested list changes are observable through the terminal trace.
